title: Ben Stokes Announces Retirement from Test Cricket, Eyes Coaching Role
summary: Cricket star Ben Stokes has announced his retirement from Test cricket, citing a desire to pursue a career as an England coach. Stokes, who is currently the limited-overs captain of England, made the announcement in a recent interview. He expressed his interest in coaching and stated that he wants to be the next England coach after his retirement from international cricket.
summary_points: Ben Stokes has announced his retirement from Test cricket
Stokes cited a desire to pursue a career as an England coach
He is currently the limited-overs captain of England
Stokes wants to be the next England coach after his retirement
